C1359.title: Venus Protocol Suffers 7th Flash Loan Attack
C1359.summary: On March 15, 2026, Venus Protocol was exploited for the seventh time on BNB Chain, resulting in a loss of approximately $3.7 million. The attacker used a flash loan to borrow substantial funds and manipulated the price of the low-liquidity token THE, allowing them to borrow blue-chip assets such as BTC, CAKE, and BNB before undercollateralized positions could be liquidated.
